headline: One team for your Reels, your pages and your leads.
story: NextGenMediaCo makes short videos and social content for local businesses. Most shop owners don't have time to shoot, edit and post every week, and hiring separate people for videos, ads and customer replies gets expensive.
So we work with what you already have. You send the photos and clips on your phone, and we turn them into finished Reels, posters and festival campaigns, then post them for you.
When you're ready for more, the same team runs your ads and your Google Business Profile, and sets up the automation that answers customers on WhatsApp.

values.title: No shoots needed
values.text: We build every video from the photos and clips you send on WhatsApp or email.

values.title: Same-day delivery
values.text: Finished videos come back fast, in the right format for each platform.

values.title: Your brand every time
values.text: Your logo, colours and pricing on every post, so customers recognise you.

values.title: Hindi, English or both
values.text: Captions and hashtags written the way your customers speak.
